notes.title: Update information Ver. 1.02
notes.notes:
We have released Version 1.02, which includes the following bug fixes:
・Fixed an issue where the resolution of character images when messages were displayed was low.
・The call button/key for the note menu can now be changed from settings.
・Translation corrections.
・Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver. 1.01
notes.notes:
[h3]We have released Version 1.01, which includes the following bug fixes:
・Fixed an issue where clear data from Kuro no Kiseki and Kuro no Kiseki II could not be loaded.
・Fixed an issue where certain DLC consumable items could not be obtained.
・Translation corrections.
・Other minor bug fixes.[/h3]

■ Regarding GPU Settings
On PCs with multiple GPUs (e.g., those with both an integrated GPU in the CPU and a discrete graphics card), the game may select a lower-performance GPU by default.
In such cases, please select the GPU to be used via "Graphics Settings" in the in-game options.
The settings will take effect after restarting the game.

■ Using the Switch Pro Controller
　1. Connect the Switch Pro Controller to your PC.
　2. Click "Steam" in the top-left corner of the Steam client and select "Settings" from the menu.
　3. Select "Controller" in the settings menu.
　4. Turn "Use Nintendo Button Layout" to OFF.

notes.title: How to Change Display Language & Resolution Settings
notes.notes:
[h3]■Changing the Display Language[/h3]
You can set the in-game display language via the Steam client:
1) In your Steam library, select the game and open "Properties."
2) Under the "General" tab, choose your preferred language from the "Language" option.

[h3]■ Resolution Settings[/h3]
The in-game resolution refers to the rendering resolution.
The display resolution on the screen depends on the window size and can be adjusted via Windows settings:
・For windowed mode, adjust the window size for Kai no Kiseki.
・For fullscreen mode, adjust the desktop resolution.
For example, with a 16:9 aspect ratio:
1080p corresponds to Full HD, 2160p corresponds to 4K, and 4320p corresponds to 8K rendering resolution.

■Please note that the game may not run on PCs that do not meet the minimum system requirements.

■Based on your PC’s specifications, limits may be applied to in-game settings such as "Resolution," "Shadow Quality," and "Anti-aliasing." These limits are designed to ensure stable gameplay by managing resource usage (e.g., VRAM).

If you wish to lift these restrictions, follow the steps below. Please note that removing these limits may cause performance issues. Proceed with caution:

1) Open the save data folder:
C:\Users\<Your Windows Username>\Saved Games\CLE\Kai_no_Kiseki\ and open the config.json file using a text editor (e.g., Notepad).
2) Locate the line "unlimited_settings": false and change "false" to "true".
3) Save the changes and launch Kai no Kiseki.
